Rudan Tile, modular steel roof panels is an innovative and unique new metal roofing product. The tiles are made of premium G90 steel, with matt crinkle look color coating with strong resistance to abrasion and corrosion. Attractive & elegant appearance combined with top quality make it top choice with architects, contractors and homeowners alike.

Trapeze can be installed over existing shingles. Trapeze is a simple sleek option which can be custom cut to suit any home or commercial building needs. A Trapeze roof is close match to the look of a Standing Seam roof (Can also be used for siding).

Steel Liner Panels are a great way to finish off your garages, workshops, labs, industrial and commercial spaces with great aesthetics and durable protection. Providing a lifetime finish and an enhancement to any structural design.

  • Stronger and more durable than drywall
  • 3x lighter than drywall
  • 29 gauge steel
  • Easy installation
  • Environmentally Friendly
  • Saves energy and heat loss
  • Available in White and Galvanized
